tickerText: [TENNIS] Ben Shelton rallied past Frances Tiafoe 4-6, 6-3, 6-3, 7-5 to reach his first Grand Slam final, where he faces Alexander Zverev after the German beat Karen Khachanov — Aryna Sabalenka and Elena Rybakina meet in the women's final with the No. 1 ranking on the line • [SQUASH] The QTerminals Qatar Classic Platinum opens first-round play in Doha as world No. 1 Mostafa Asal hunts his first title and Nouran Gohar makes her PSA return after maternity leave • [BADMINTON] Asian Games badminton looms Sept 19–29 as An Se-young's unbeaten China Masters run and Satwik-Chirag's first China Masters crown fuel medal hopes in Japan • [PICKLEBALL] Tardio and Khlif reach the KL Cup men's doubles semis Saturday at The Hood after storming back from a 3-11 opener as the PPA Asia 1000 heads to Sunday's medal matches • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Macao quarterfinals day pits Zhou Qihao against Tomokazu Harimoto and Chen Xingtong against Dina Meshref before Sunday's semis and finals at the East Asian Games Dome

newsItems.title: Shelton Books US Open Final
newsItems.excerpt: Ben Shelton came from a set down to beat Frances Tiafoe 4-6, 6-3, 6-3, 7-5 and will face Alexander Zverev on Sunday for a chance to become the first American man to win the US Open since 2003.

newsItems.title: Qatar Classic Begins in Doha
newsItems.excerpt: The QTerminals Qatar Classic Platinum is underway at the Khalifa International Tennis and Squash Complex, headlined by Mostafa Asal's title chase and Nouran Gohar's comeback after a year away from the PSA Tour.

newsItems.title: Stars Gear Up for Asian Games
newsItems.excerpt: An Se-young's seventh title of 2026 at the China Masters and Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty's maiden Super 750 win set the stage as badminton's Asian Games open in Aichi-Nagoya on September 19.

newsItems.title: Macao Quarterfinals Underway
newsItems.excerpt: Quarterfinal day at WTT Champions Macao features Zhou Qihao versus Tomokazu Harimoto and Chen Xingtong against Dina Meshref, with semifinals and finals scheduled for Sunday at the East Asian Games Dome.
